en: Unit 5
Exploring space
Where are we in the universe?
In this unit, you will:

name things in space and describe ways to explore space.

A What can we see in the sky?
zh: 我们在天空中能看到什么？

en: 🟠 Let's talk
Miss White is talking to Mrs Green before class. Listen and choose. 🎧
zh: 上课前，怀特老师正在和格林老师交谈。听录音并选择。🎧

en: What class will Mrs Green have this afternoon?
zh: 格林老师今天下午上什么课？

en: A. Maths. B. Science. C. PE.
Where was Mr Liu before?
A. On the space station. B. In the science museum. C. At school.
Mr Liu: Hi, children. Let's talk about our planet Earth today. What can you see in the sky?
zh: 刘老师：大家好。今天我们来谈谈我们的地球。你们在天空中能看到什么？

en: Mike: The sky is often blue in the daytime. We can see the Sun and the clouds. We can also see birds and planes.
zh: 迈克：白天天空通常是蓝色的。我们可以看到太阳和云朵，还可以看到鸟和飞机。

en: Amy: At night, we can see the Moon and the stars.
zh: 艾米：晚上，我们可以看到月亮和星星。

en: Mr Liu: Very good. But what can we see from outer space? Let's look at some photos from a space station.
zh: 刘老师：非常好。但从外太空我们能看到什么呢？让我们来看一些来自空间站的照片。

en: Binbin: Wow! We can see mountains, oceans and clouds. How wonderful!
zh: 彬彬：哇！我们可以看到山脉、海洋和云朵。真是太壮观了！

en: Chen Jie: There are large oceans on Earth. It looks like a big blue marble.
zh: 陈洁：地球上有广阔的海洋。它看起来像一颗巨大的蓝色弹珠。

en: Mr Liu: Right. Earth also has some beautiful names. For example, the Blue Planet and Mother Earth.
zh: 刘老师：对。地球还有一些美丽的名字，例如蓝色星球和地球母亲。

en: Mike: I like those names. I want to know more about our Mother Earth!
zh: 迈克：我喜欢这些名字。我想更多地了解我们的地球母亲！

en: What can Mike and Amy see in the sky?
zh: 迈克和艾米在天空中能看到什么？

en: What can you see in the sky?
zh: 你在天空中能看到什么？

en: 🟠 Choose and talk
from a hill
from a plane
from the Moon
What can you see from ...?
I can see buildings, a river, ...
1. What class will Mrs Green have this afternoon? B. Science.
2. Where was Mr Liu before? A. On the space station.
What can Mike and Amy see in the sky? Mike can see the Sun, clouds, birds and planes. Amy can see the Moon and the stars.

en: 🟠 Let's learn
Hi, I'm Earth. I'm a planet. I travel around the Sun. Satellites travel around me.
zh: 大家好，我是地球。我是一颗行星。我绕着太阳运转。卫星绕着我运转。

en: The Moon is my neighbour. It travels around me too. People can often see the Moon and the stars at night.
zh: 月亮是我的邻居。它也绕着我运转。人们晚上经常可以看到月亮和星星。

en: Earth is a planet. It travels around the Sun. The Moon ...
zh: 地球是一颗行星。它绕着太阳运转。月亮……

en: 🟠 Look, compare and say
At night, we can see the Moon and the stars from Earth. We can see some planets too.
zh: 晚上，我们可以从地球上看到月亮和星星，还可以看到一些行星。

en: In the daytime, we can see ...
Earth is a planet. It travels around the Sun. The Moon ... The Moon is Earth's neighbour. It travels around Earth. People can often see the Moon and the stars at night.
In the daytime, we can see ... In the daytime, we can see the Sun, clouds, birds and hot-air balloons.
B What do we know about Earth and its neighbours?
zh: 我们对地球及其邻居了解多少？

en: 🟠 Let's talk
Chen Jie is showing Miss White a magazine. Listen and choose. 🎧
zh: 陈洁正在给怀特老师看一本杂志。听录音并选择。🎧

en: What is the magazine about?
zh: 这本杂志是关于什么的？

en: A. Mars. B. The Sun. C. The Moon.
Why can't we live there?
zh: 为什么我们不能住在那里？

en: A. It is red. B. It is too far. C. The air is thin.
Mike: Hey, Chen Jie. What are you reading about?
zh: 迈克：嘿，陈洁。你在看关于什么的内容？

en: Chen Jie: Mars.
Matt: Mars? What does it say?
zh: 马特：火星？上面写了什么？

en: Chen Jie: It talks about things on Mars.
zh: 陈洁：它介绍了火星上的事物。

en: Matt: Wow! Is there any water on Mars?
Chen Jie: Yes, there is. There is soil too.
Matt: Oh! Are there any aliens?
zh: 马特：哦！那里有外星人吗？

en: Chen Jie: I don't think so. They say there aren't any living things.
zh: 陈洁：我认为没有。据说那里没有任何生物。

en: Matt: I see.
Chen Jie: Look! This is the sunrise on Mars.
zh: 陈洁：看！这是火星上的日出。

en: Mike: How beautiful! I really want to travel to Mars.
zh: 迈克：多美啊！我真的很想去火星旅行。

en: Chen Jie: Maybe you can go one day. China already put a rover on Mars. We learn more about the "red planet" every year.
zh: 陈洁：也许有一天你可以去。中国已经在火星上放置了一辆探测车。我们每年都在更多地了解这颗"红色星球"。

en: What is on Mars?
What else do you know about Mars?
zh: 关于火星，你还知道什么？

en: 🟠 Look and role-play
What can you see in the sky?
zh: 你在天空中能看到什么？

en: I can see Earth and the Sun.
Is there any water on Mars?
Yes, there is.
Ask more questions to the rover.
zh: 向探测车提出更多问题。

en: 1. What is the magazine about? A. Mars.
2. Why can't we live there? C. The air is thin.
What is on Mars? There is water and soil on Mars. There is also a beautiful sunrise on Mars.
What else do you know about Mars? Mars is called the "red planet." China put a rover on Mars to explore it.
Role-play（
zh: 更多问题示例）: — Is there any air on Mars? — No, there isn't enough air for people to breathe. — Are there any plants on Mars? — No, there aren't any plants on Mars.

en: 🟠 Let's learn
We explore space in different ways.
zh: 我们用不同的方式探索太空。

en: We can look into space with telescopes.
zh: 我们可以用望远镜观测太空。

en: Astronauts go into space.
They use a spaceship to fly there.
zh: 他们乘坐宇宙飞船飞往太空。

en: Some astronauts live for months on a space station.
zh: 一些宇航员在空间站上生活数月。

en: How can we explore space?
There are many ways. We can ...
zh: 有很多种方式。我们可以……

en: 🟠 Look, think and talk
What do people use to explore space?
zh: 人们用什么来探索太空？

en: We use telescopes, ...
What is man-made in the picture?
The space station, ...
How can we explore space? There are many ways. We can ... We can use telescopes to look into space. Astronauts can go into space by spaceship. They can live and work on a space station.
What do people use to explore space? We use telescopes, spaceships, rovers and space stations to explore space.
What is man-made in the picture? The space station, the spaceship, the rover and the satellite are man-made.
🟠 Read and write 🎧
Do you know any Chinese astronauts? List their names.
zh: 你认识哪些中国宇航员？列出他们的名字。

en: What do you know about an astronaut's life in space?
zh: 关于宇航员在太空中的生活，你了解什么？

en: What do astronauts do?
Chinese astronauts are called taikonauts. Their life in space is special.
zh: 中国宇航员被称为太空人。他们在太空中的生活很特别。

en: The taikonauts get up early in the morning. But getting ready is different. They can't use water to wash their faces. So taikonauts have to use a wet cloth. They brush their teeth with a special toothpaste and have to "eat" it!
zh: 太空人早晨早早起床。但他们的准备工作与众不同。他们不能用水洗脸，所以太空人必须用湿布擦脸。他们用特殊牙膏刷牙，并且必须把它"吃"掉！

en: Each day the taikonauts are very busy. They do a lot of work. For example, they grow vegetables and rice. Sometimes, they also give classes to children and answer questions about space.
zh: 太空人每天都非常忙碌。他们要做很多工作。例如，他们种植蔬菜和水稻。有时，他们还给孩子们上课并回答关于太空的问题。

en: It is hard work. The taikonauts must stay healthy. Every afternoon they do exercise to keep healthy and strong. But their job is also very interesting. They can see the sunrise and sunset 16 times a day. The view is amazing! There is no other job like this one.
zh: 这是一项艰苦的工作。太空人必须保持健康。他们每天下午锻炼，以保持健康和强壮。但他们的工作也非常有趣。他们每天能看到16次日出和日落。景色令人叹为观止！没有任何其他工作能与之相比。

C Project: Share the facts of Earth, the Sun and the Moon
zh: 项目：分享关于地球、太阳和月球的知识

en: 1 What questions can we ask about the Sun? Listen and complete the sentences. 🎧
zh: 我们可以对太阳提出哪些问题？听录音并补全句子。🎧

en: Can a _______________ fly to the Sun?
Can _______________ feel the warmth of the Sun in the _______________?
Are there any _______________ around the Sun?
2 Work in groups to make fact cards about space.
zh: 分组合作，制作关于太空的知识卡片。

en: Facts about the Sun
It is a star. There isn't any life on it. It gives us light and keeps us warm.
zh: 它是一颗恒星。上面没有任何生命。它给我们光和温暖。

en: Facts about Earth
It is a planet. There are oceans, mountains and _______________. There are _______________ around Earth.
Facts about astronauts
An astronaut studies space, stars and planets. They work in a _______________. They go there by _______________.
zh: 宇航员研究太空、星星和行星。他们在_______________工作。他们乘坐_______________前往那里。

en: What facts do you know about the Sun?
zh: 关于太阳，你了解哪些知识？

en: The Sun gives us light and keeps us warm.
Is there any life on the Sun?
No, there isn't. It ...
Is the Sun a star?
Can a spaceship fly to the Sun?
Can astronauts feel the warmth of the Sun in the space station?

zh: 填空）: It is a planet. There are oceans, mountains and forests. There are satellites around Earth.

zh: 在班级里分享这些知识。

en: The Sun is very big and hot. There isn't any life on it. But it gives us light and keeps us warm.
zh: 太阳非常大而且炽热。上面没有任何生命。但它给我们光和温暖。

en: Earth goes around the Sun. So we have four seasons. Earth spins, so we have day and night. In the daytime, we can see planes, birds, ...
zh: 地球绕着太阳运转，所以我们有四个季节。地球自转，所以我们有白天和黑夜。白天，我们可以看到飞机、鸟……

en: An astronaut studies space, stars and planets. They work in ...
zh: 宇航员研究太空、星星和行星。他们在……工作。

zh: 我能分享关于地球和火星的知识。

en: Reading time
Some fun facts about our solar system
zh: 关于我们太阳系的趣味知识

en: English
Mercury
Venus
Earth
Mars
Jupiter
Saturn
Uranus
Neptune
Moon
①
The closest planet to the Sun is not the hottest.
zh: 离太阳最近的行星并不是最热的。

en: The hottest planet is Venus. It has a temperature of about 467°C.
zh: 最热的行星是金星。它的温度约为467摄氏度。

en: ②
Jupiter's storm may be more than 300 years old.
zh: 木星上的风暴可能已经持续了300多年。

en: The name of the big storm on Jupiter is the Great Red Spot. It is wider than Earth.
zh: 木星上这场大风暴的名字叫大红斑。它比地球还宽。

en: ③
Neptune has the fastest wind in the solar system.
zh: 海王星拥有太阳系中最快的风。

en: Neptune's winds can reach over 2,000 kilometres per hour.
zh: 海王星的风速可以超过每小时2000千米。

en: Is there any water on these planets?
Very little.
So there are no fish out there.
④
Saturn has over ten moons.
It may have more! Scientists are still looking for them.
zh: 它可能还有更多！科学家们仍在寻找它们。

en: Are there any footprints on the Moon? How old are they?
zh: 月球上有脚印吗？它们有多少年了？

en: ⑤
Footprints on the Moon could stay there for a very long time.
zh: 月球上的脚印可以在那里保留很长时间。

en: They could be there for thousands of years!
zh: 它们可能会在那里保留数千年！

en: ⑥
There are thousands of pieces of space junk floating around Earth.
zh: 有数千块太空垃圾漂浮在地球周围。

en: Space junk is man-made objects left in space. And the number is growing!
zh: 太空垃圾是遗留在太空中的人造物体。而且数量还在不断增加！

en: What other facts do you know?
zh: 你还知道哪些趣味知识？

en: Are there any footprints on the Moon? How old are they? Yes, there are footprints on the Moon. They are over 50 years old. Astronauts left them when they visited the Moon.
What other facts do you know? Mars is called the "red planet." The Sun is a star, not a planet. Earth is the only planet with life.
